home.heroSub: Eleven frames carrying the names of eleven places. Each one tells a part of the city that inspired it.
home.manifestoP1: Venice is a city built on water by people who had no alternative. Everything came out of that necessity: the engineering, the trade, the beauty. Venezia Eyewear starts there — from the idea that perfect form is born of a constraint, not a whim.
home.manifestoP2: From the Rialto to La Fenice, from the Arsenale to the Accademia, every frame carries the name of a specific place and inherits its character. This is not marketing: it is a design method.
manifestoList: Proportions worked out on real measurements
home.collectionMen: Structure, geometry, presence. Frames built to outlast trends.
home.collectionWomen: Restrained curves and short proportions. Character without statements.
home.collectionUnisex: The most essential shapes in the collection. They work on anyone with patience for detail.
home.anatomyText: A frame is not beautiful or ugly in the abstract: it is right or wrong for one particular face. These are the four measurements that decide it.
home.anatomyCalibre: The width of one lens. It determines how much of the face the frame occupies.
home.anatomyBridge: The distance between the lenses. It decides whether the frame slides down the nose.
home.anatomyFront: The total width of the front. It should follow the width of the cheekbones.
home.anatomyTemple: The length of the temple. It decides how the frame holds behind the ear.
home.retailersText: Proportions are judged in a mirror, not on a screen. Find your nearest optician or request an appointment.
home.newsletterText: A few emails a year, only when something new comes out.
home.quote: Venice is not visited: it is crossed. And every time it hands back a detail that wasn't there before.
